title: Kiritani Haruka — Fantastic Training Room!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Bedroom

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's take what we discussed today and do our best again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Thanks again for sticking around so late for us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You're welcome.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm sure your first day of shooting was very taxing, so please get plenty of rest.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
I feel exhausted after using my head so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. But that allowed us to have a productive debrief.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we start getting ready for bed?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, wait, before we do—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's something I want to do first. Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, we gotta call our moms!
I'm sure they're wondering how we're doing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. We're going to be here for a while, so it'll be important to reassure them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I was actually referring to us getting our room all straightened out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our room...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is going to be our base of operations starting today, so I think we should come up with a good organization scheme.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, all our things are still in our bags.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree that we should get organized sooner rather than later, since things are bound to get busy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, let's do that today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all for understanding.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're allowed to use this chest of drawers however we like, so why don't we decide what to fill them with?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We can put our uniforms and stage outfits in the closet, and the rest of our clothes can go in the chest.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm seeing four drawers, so that means we each get one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What should we do with our streaming equipment?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good question...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we put it in the empty space over there? We could also place this table nearby to make a video-editing station.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, we could create a relaxation area by bringing this sofa over here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, I can already tell our base is gonna look really nice!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're such a talented interior designer, Haruka. Your producer skills shine through.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is really nothing special.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I do want to set things up so we can perform well, since this next month is going to be important for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, we still need to decide...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Ah, that's right.
Who's going to sleep in which bed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We have two bunk beds.
Shizuku and I will take this one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, Minori and I will use this one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which would you like, Minori? Top or bottom bunk?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Umm...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wouldn't dream of putting myself above you, Haruka, but I also don't want to make you have to climb up and down each time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What do I do?! I can't decide!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You don't have to think so hard about this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's clearly a very important decision to her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we do this?
Shizuku and I will take the top bunks, while you two take the bottom ones.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That'd solve all your problems, right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Wait, doesn't that mean I'll be sleeping next to Haruka...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Knowing that is gonna make me so anxious!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Then, that's it for the beds.
Why don't we take a look at the bathroom next?
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew... That should do it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, the second MORE MORE HOUSE, AKA “The Grand Prix Branch”, is open for business...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: From this new base, let's keep making progress towards our dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Lots of progress!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But not to the point where you burn out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I understand exactly how you feel, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I got a clear sense today of just how serious the other groups are about this grand prix.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I knew that all of them would be fully committed to this, but actually seeing them really put my head in the game.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, but we're just as driven as they are.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, let's make sure we get through the prelim stage and advance to the final stage...!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get that sleep now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good night, everyone. I hope you all sleep tight.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Good night.
